path='research/jev-bounded-judgment/phase1/followup-05-cross-family/staging/big-pickle/results/scored.ndjson'

    print(mech, f'total_unanswerable={total} pred_nonnull={with_pred} abstained_true={with_abstained_true} abstained_false={with_abstained_false} correct_dist={dict(correct_vals)}')

import json
path='research/jev-bounded-judgment/phase1/followup-05-cross-family/staging/big-pickle/results/scored.ndjson'
gm={}; jev={}
with open(path) as f:
    for line in f:
        o=json.loads(line)
        if o['mechanism']=='general_model': gm[o['case_id']]=o
        elif o['mechanism']=='jev': jev[o['case_id']]=o
diffs=[]
for cid in sorted(set(gm)&set(jev)):
    if gm[cid]['pred_label']!=jev[cid]['pred_label']:
        diffs.append((cid, gm[cid]['pred_label'], jev[cid]['pred_label'], gm[cid]['answerable']))
        print(cid, f\"gm_pred={gm[cid]['pred_label']} jev_pred={jev[cid]['pred_label']} answerable={gm[cid]['answerable']} gm_correct={gm[cid]['correct']} jev_correct={jev[cid]['correct']}\")
print(f'n_diffs={len(diffs)} total_compared={len(gm)}')
# confirm no answerable diffs
print('answerable diffs:', [d for d in diffs if d[3] is True])
print('unanswerable diffs:', [d for d in diffs if d[3] is False])
"
